detail.longDescription: 🚀 NC-Gantt 2.8 is here! Plan and steer projects like a pro: budgeted vs. actual costs with warnings & EAC, built-in time tracking with approvals and a public time-entry link (no account needed), plus burndown & cost curve (S-curve) charts from daily snapshots. Also new: ownerless resource pools. # ProjectManagement # Gantt # Nextcloud # OpenSource # DigitalSovereignty # TimeTracking # SelfHosted # FOSS
